definitions.gloss: to crawl up, to clamber up
definitions.explanation: To climb upward by crawling; to ascend with difficulty using hands and body.

definitions.gloss: to rise from a difficult situation
definitions.explanation: (Figurative) To struggle up from hardship or a low position; to work one's way up.

examples.english: The baby is trying to crawl up the stairs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{這|は}い{上|あ}がった。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). Compound verb: ⟦{這|は}う→這う：00094_hau⟧ + ⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧.

COMPOUND VERB PATTERN: ～⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ compounds indicate upward movement:
- ⟦{駆|か}け{上|あ}がる→駆け上がる：06110_kakeagaru⟧ (to run up)
- ⟦{浮|う}き{上|あ}がる→浮き上がる：06042_ukiagaru⟧ (to float up)
- ⟦{飛|と}び{上|あ}がる→飛び上がる：06345_tobiagaru⟧ (to jump up)
- ⟦{這|は}い{出|で}る→這い出る：06843_haideru⟧ (to crawl out - related)

FIGURATIVE USE: Common in rags-to-riches stories and descriptions of overcoming adversity.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{地獄|じごく}→地獄：12053_jigoku⟧から{這|は}い{上|あ}がる (rise from hell)
- ⟦どん{底|ぞこ}→どん底：08781_donzoko⟧から{這|は}い{上|あ}がる (rise from rock bottom)
